corpus: P113 fixed size32:13 versioned chunks,367canonical units,3synthetic known documents. Reuse20already-known questions/gold; not blind evaluation.

reranker.output: Single raw relevance logit per(query,passage). No sigmoid/probability interpretation. Last batch repeated to8for exported static axis; padded outputs recorded but not ranked.

generator.profile: Tokenizer chat template, explicit generation prompt, no added special tokens after template, no truncation. One execution per unique exact prompt/profile, shared by identical scenarios.

context.policy: Greedy whole chunks in ranking order; count actual rendered context tokens including aliases/separators using generator tokenizer, skip over budget or over3chunks; no hidden gold,neighbor expansion or clipped text.

answers: 20questions×2retrievers×with/without rerank=80scenarios. Same local generator,prompt andbudget. Include empty contexts. Preserve raw text andtoken IDs of every unique prompt,even format failures or unsupported claims. No favorable retries.
citation: Aliases S01..S13 map to exact immutable chunks. Validate alias,provided-context membership,documentID,byte version,representationID and exact canonical UTF16range. Existing link does not prove support. Static source resolver highlights the exact source span.
evaluation: Rubric fixed before outcomes; editorial assistant annotations after reading answers,not blind or independently adjudicated. Separate format,source-link validity,claim support,answer coverage,grounded completeness,abstention andtechnical rejection. Do not infer semantic support from mere citation existence.
selection: Preserve all losses/unchanged cases/negative questions. No tuning prompt,weights,thresholds,contextbudget or labels after reading outcomes. A new experiment needs new paths/protocol; never overwrite these captures.
limits: Small known synthetic corpus,no production capacity claim,no calibrated confidence/noanswer threshold. No claim that source-consistent assertions are universally true.
